title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Surallah in the Province of Cotabato
title.orig: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Four Hundred Twenty, Entitled “An Act Creating the Municipality of Surallah in the Province of Cotabato”

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3664_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Section two of the same Act is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
